title: Multiple Teams Emerging as Potential Suitors for Rising Denver Nuggets Talent - NewsBreak
text:
By Shabiha Akter ,
1 hours ago
Denver Nuggets Logo (Image Credits: Imagn) The Denver Nuggets are doing everything possible to keep their postseason hopes alive. After falling behind the Minnesota Timberwolves in their first-round series, Denver bounced back with a strong performance to force a Game 6 .
The Denver team remains focused on the playoffs. However, several franchises have already started monitoring Denver’s players’ availability ahead of the offseason. Marc Stein reported that the Lakers, Bulls, and Nets could emerge as potential suitors for Peyton Watson.
“League sources have already identified the Lakers, Bulls, and Nets as potential suitors that are likely to have the requisite spending power to present an offer sheet that causes angst in the Rocky Mountains. The Stein Line has learned, in fact, that both the Lakers and Bulls registered trade interest in Watson leading up to the in-season deadline for deals on Feb. 5, although it must be noted that Chicago’s front office will soon have a new lead voice after the recent ouster of former Nuggets executive Artūras Karnišovas ,” the report read.
In his fourth season with the Nuggets, Watson has taken his talent to a whole new level. This season, he has averaged his career-best 14.6 points, 4.9 rebounds, and 2.1 assists per game in 54 games. Hence, interest in the young star is expected to be high.
Peyton Watson’s Injury Keeps Him Out of Denver Nuggets’ Rotation Watson has not appeared in any of the first five games of the series against Minnesota. The Nuggets star continues to recover from a hamstring strain that sidelined him during the crucial playoff stretch.
Peyton Watson (Image Credits: Imagn) Injuries have been a recurring challenge throughout his career. Just two seasons ago, the 23-year-old played only 80 regular-season games. The latest setback has been especially frustrating, as it involves the same hamstring injury that sidelined him for more than six weeks earlier this year.
Even while out of the lineup, Watson remains a hot topic in league rumors. He is set to become a restricted free agent this summer. Because of that status, the Nuggets will have the opportunity to match any offer he receives.
The post Multiple Teams Emerging as Potential Suitors for Rising Denver Nuggets Talent originally published on Total Pro Sports .
